audience: store owners and staff who run a shop, or their bookkeepers, on Decimal POS

useCases.title: Check the price and stock of an item by its code
useCases.text: Look up one product by its SKU or UPC code and read its price and stock. List the products changed since your last sync to update a catalog.

useCases.title: Find a customer by phone number
useCases.text: Search a customer by their 10-digit phone number. Then read the contact details on file for that customer. Request only the data the task needs.

useCases.title: Trace a web order to its invoice
useCases.text: Find an order by the external id that your shop system set. Then read the invoice of that order, with its lines, taxes and payments.

useCases.title: Count the units of an item sold on one ticket
useCases.text: Read how many units of one item sold on a ticket, net of returns. A missing ticket or line returns a quantity of 0.

useCases.title: Review the sales of one item over a date window
useCases.text: List the item codes your key may query for sale history. Then list the invoice lines that sold one item in a window of up to 31 days.

useCases.title: Check a supplier bill by its invoice number
useCases.text: Find every vendor bill that carries one supplier's invoice number. Open a bill to read its items, the amounts paid and the balance.
